***The Company’s Board of Directors Declares Special Cash Dividend of $2.00 Per Share***


HOUSTON


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Nutex Health Inc. (“Nutex Health” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq Global Market and Nasdaq Texas: NUTX), today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”), acting by unanimous approval of its independent directors, has declared a special cash dividend of $2.00 per share of the Company’s common stock, par value $0.001 per share. The dividend is the first cash dividend in the Company’s history as a public company.


The special dividend is payable on December 14, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 30, 2026. Payment of the dividend is conditioned upon delivery to the independent directors of a customary certificate of the Company’s Chief Financial Officer prior to the payment date, and the Board has reserved the right to revoke or modify the dividend prior to the payment date.


Management of Nutex Health anticipates recommending to the Board’s independent directors the payment of future regular quarterly cash dividends. However, the declaration, timing, and amount of any future dividends are subject to the review and approval of the Board’s independent directors. Whether to declare any future dividend, and the amount, record date and payment date of any such dividend, will be determined by the Board in its discretion and will depend on the Company’s financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, contractual restrictions, compliance with applicable law and other factors the Board deems relevant. There can be no assurance that any future dividend will be declared at similar levels or at all paid.


“Declaring our first cash dividend as a public company reflects our commitment to delivering value to stockholders and our confidence in the strength and stability of our company,” stated Tom Vo, M.D., MBA, Chairman and CEO of Nutex Health. “Our strong cash flow and solid balance sheet allow us to return capital to stockholders while continuing to invest in long-term growth.”


**About Nutex Health Inc.**


Headquartered in Houston, Texas, and founded in 2011, Nutex Health Inc. (Nasdaq Global Market and Nasdaq Texas: NUTX) is a healthcare management and operations company with three divisions: a Hospital Division, Population Health Management Division, and Real Estate Division.


The Hospital Division owns, develops, and operates innovative healthcare models, including micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments. This division owns and operates 28 facilities in 12 states.


The Population Health Management Division owns and operates provider networks such as Independent Physician Associations. Through our Management Services Organization, we provide management, administrative, and other support services to our affiliated hospitals and physician groups.


The Real Estate Division comprises real estate entities along with activities related to the development and construction of hospital facilities. The real estate entities own the land and hospital buildings which are leased to our hospital entities.
